sturdy-boots.name: Sturdy Boots
sturdy-boots.description: Fall damage and incoming knockback reduced 8%.

vitality-seed.name: Vitality Seed
vitality-seed.description: Regenerate 1 HP/s after six seconds without enemy damage.

thunder-stone.name: Thunder Stone
thunder-stone.description: Every fifth damaging primary hit chains 8 lightning damage to one other visible enemy within 5 blocks. One-second internal cooldown.

blast-core.name: Blast Core
blast-core.description: Eligible explosive weapon/ability radius +20%; damage unchanged.

recovery-gem.name: Recovery Gem
recovery-gem.description: Regenerate 3 HP/s after five seconds without enemy damage.

frost-fang.name: Frost Fang
frost-fang.description: Every fourth damaging primary hit slows its target 20% for 1.5 seconds. DoT does not count.

emergency-armor.name: Emergency Armor
emergency-armor.description: Crossing below 30% HP grants 20% resistance for four seconds. 30-second cooldown.

phoenix-heart.name: Phoenix Heart
phoenix-heart.description: Once per round, survive lethal damage at 20 HP with one second of protection.

storm-bringer.name: Storm Bringer
storm-bringer.description: Every fourth damaging primary hit deals 12 lightning damage to visible enemies within 4 blocks. One-second internal cooldown.

berserkers-fury.name: Berserker’s Fury
berserkers-fury.description: Deal 20% more player damage while below 40% HP. Item damage is not amplified.

echo-strike.name: Echo Strike
echo-strike.description: Every fifth primary hit repeats 50% of its damage without triggering other weapon items.

gravity-core.name: Gravity Core
gravity-core.description: Direct damage slows an enemy 15% for two seconds. Six-second cooldown.

second-wind.name: Second Wind
second-wind.description: Eliminations restore 20 HP and grant +15% movement speed for three seconds.

ultimate-engine.name: Ultimate Engine
ultimate-engine.description: Ultimate charge generation +25% (combined item bonus capped at 35%).

void-armor.name: Void Armor
void-armor.description: Taking 25 HP damage within two seconds grants 25% resistance for three seconds. 20-second cooldown.

hunters-instinct.name: Hunter’s Instinct
hunters-instinct.description: Direct damage grants +15% movement speed for two seconds. Five-second cooldown.
